gloss_en: head (rosh, רֹאשׁ) — the head as seat of the brain and consciousness (mochin), used symbolically for whatever stands at the top/beginning: the tzaddik as head of Israel and of the generations, 'rosh bayit' (head of the house), and the 'head' of the year; distinct from רָשׁ (poor man) with which it is contrasted in the wine dictum
